name: Iona Medved
source:
"But I guess we should distract ourselves from that. There's no point in stressing over things we really can't change."

Like his father before him, lona is an experienced gambler, whose skill allows him to collect considerable earnings despite his age and the illegality of such things in connection to that. Rather materialistic, he places great importance on money, and expresses interest in the many expensive things in the castle.

He comes across more laidback than most others, not often displaying strong emotional reactions or getting too involved in any debates or arguments when they occur. Despite this, though, he does demonstrate a tendency to complain about seemingly insignificant things, even when there may be more pressing issues at hand.

Underneath all of this, he is rather self-aware, acknowledging his many bad habits and conscious of his flaws as a person.
